attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 15 streaming replication across node1 (primary, writable) and node2/node3 (async physical standbys, read-only). Verified writes on node1 replicate to both standbys and that standbys reject writes. Performed the mandatory sequential restart of node2, node3, then node1, confirming changed boot identity and full recovery (postgresql-15 active, standbys re-streaming, replicated data intact) after each restart.
